#nullable enable
using LoadReferenceData.Csv;
using LoadReferenceData.TestDoubles;
using Xunit;

namespace LoadReferenceData.Tests;

public class FF_SRC_DesignationSourceTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void FF_SRC_Designation_ReportsItsOwnName()
    {
        using var harness = new PackageHarness();
        var package = harness.Package();
        var source = package.FF_SRC_Designation();

        Assert.Equal("FF_SRC_Designation", source.Name);
    }

    [Fact]
    [Trait("Category", "Integration")]
    public async Task FF_SRC_Designation_ReadsRealRows_AgainstARealFile()
    {
        using var harness = new PackageHarness();
        var package = harness.Package();
        var source = package.FF_SRC_Designation();

        var rows = new List<DesignationCsvRow>();
        await foreach (var row in source.ReadAsync(CancellationToken.None)) rows.Add(row);

        Assert.NotNull(rows);
    }
}
